criteria.physical: lift >= 0.03m and both robot bilateral contacts and no weld continuously >=2s
criteria.local_pilot_gate: visual succeeds in at least 5 of 6; report paired playback and feature errors without claiming statistical generalization

matching: both conditions identical fixture, initial RGB hashes, 16 recovery rounds, .45 simulation seconds per round, close/lift/hold commands; differs only image-derived corrections
scope: Same fixed base poses/object/camera/seed; unseen local servo perturbations, not independent approach or task-level generalization. First wrist-plus37 pilot was viewed before declaring this cohort and is a repeated diagnostic case, not untouched validation. Other five have not run.
cost: local numpy/OpenCV fit; no neural network/LLM/API calls; record wall time and raw servo action count
source_sha: the commit containing this declaration (resolve with git history)
